key_insight: Soft-MoQE learns input-dependent combinations of fixed quantum feature maps, avoiding quantum-parameter optimization while achieving task-dependent performance comparable to a trainable quantum neural network.
engineering_relevance: Moving trainable routing to a classical network reduces quantum training cost by orders of magnitude in the reported benchmarks.
method: Build a heterogeneous pool of fixed, non-trainable quantum circuits.
Train a classical gating network to weight each circuit's embedding per input.
Combine quantum embeddings using the learned soft routing.
evidence_signal: On PCA-reduced MNIST parity, MNIST 10-class, and FashionMNIST tasks, Soft-MoQE outperforms the best single expert, uniform expert averaging, and a linear baseline.
watch_item: Evaluation is limited to three PCA-reduced image tasks; scalability and robustness on noisy quantum hardware remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
